dct_title_s: King County, Washington : street network (Metro Transit emitter locations)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Metro Transit Automated Vehicle Locator (AVL) emitter locations. Emitters are small, battery powered radio transmitters mounted on telephone or power poles that identifies a point used to inform a radio receiver of the location of a vehicle. Emitter locations are shown here as the nearest arc from the street networks datalayer. Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties.

Purpose: Operations; Automatic Passenger Counter & transit security use the data to determine revenue vehicle location at all times. Camera systems also use the data to determine locations; time & date for the buses. It supports web applications mybus; busview & bustime to assist customers to find the location and time for the bus. APC emitters will probably be replaced by AVL (Automated Vehicle Locator) emitters in the near future. Based on TIGER data, the King County street network layer is suitable for general reference, small-scale map displays, and network analysis. Future enhancements include deriving this data set directly from RECDNET.
